cohort: 424 neonates admitted to the NICU (Indoor or Outdoor Department) of Combined Military Hospital Quetta Pakistan between January and December 2020.
finding: Respiratory-related disorders were the most common reason for admission (43.6%), followed by infection/sepsis (24.8%) and prematurity (19.1%), with an overall mortality rate of 8%.
gest_age: Varied (significant mean difference observed between admission reasons)
followup_time: Duration of NICU stay (varied, significant mean difference observed)
birth_weight: Varied (significant mean difference observed between admission reasons)
